name: mab-bernoulli
description: Classical MAB: 10 Bernoulli instances with 10 arms (means uniform in [0.05, 0.95], gap >= 0.05), 2 runs each. Theoretical defaults.

notices.title: Default hyperparameters
notices.text: UCB1, UCB1Tuned, UCBV, UCBMinV1 and KLUCB keep the values of their papers (alpha=1: theoretical confidence bounds). These values are safe in theory but often explore too much in practice. To fit them to this problem, run a grid search (param_grid=True, or "param_grid": true in a config file) or set them, e.g. UCB1(alpha=0.1).

notices.title: Not stored
notices.text: Per-action estimates (track "estimates"); action of every step (track "actions"); peak memory (measure_memory=True). The dashboard and the figures cannot show what is not stored; the brackets say how to store it (in a config file: "track": [...] or "measure_memory": true in "experiment").

notices.title: Curves thinned
notices.text: Curves are stored every 50 steps (log_interval=50) and at the last step.

notices.title: Parallel runs
notices.text: With n_jobs=4, each process uses one BLAS thread: compare CPU times only between runs with the same n_jobs.
